tools.name: search_x402_endpoints
tools.description: Search the router's continuously probed registry of ~24,000 LIVE x402 pay-per-call endpoints. Returns the best-ranked matches with price (USDC), crawl latency, reliability_pct (share of the last <=20 probes that answered HTTP 402), networks and payTo. Free.

tools.name: route_x402_request
tools.description: Pick the best-scored LIVE x402 endpoint for a task and return it with the top 3 alternatives (the same answer as the free POST /route). For a live-checked pick with fallbacks and the full ranked list, see get_paid_route_requirements. Free.

tools.name: compare_x402_endpoints
tools.description: Compare 2-5 x402 endpoints side by side (pass urls), or the top 5 matches for a task (pass q/category/chain/max_price): price, latency, reliability over the last crawl probes, valid 402, networks and payTo, with a winner plus the cheapest, fastest and most reliable. Free.

tools.name: get_endpoint_reliability
tools.description: Probe history of one x402 endpoint url: status, success rate over the last <=20 crawl probes, consecutive failures, last seen. Returns found=false for urls the router does not track. Free.

tools.name: get_x402_changes
tools.description: Recent payTo (receiving wallet) and price changes of x402 endpoints, observed by the router's own crawl probes of the live 402. Only values that were stable and then changed are alerts; endpoints that use per-request deposit addresses or metered prices are classified (payto_rotating / price_dynamic)

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_paid_route_requirements" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: route_x402_request, compare_x402_endpoints, get_endpoint_reliability, get_x402_changes, get_paid_route_requirements, route_paid · Private data: get_x402_changes, get_paid_route_requirements · Public sink: search_x402_endpoints, route_x402_request, get_paid_route_requirements, route_paid.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: route_x402_request, compare_x402_endpoints, get_endpoint_reliability, get_x402_changes, get_paid_route_requirements, route_paid · Private data: get_x402_changes, get_paid_route_requirements · Public sink: search_x402_endpoints, route_x402_request, get_paid_route_requirements, route_paid

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
